_comment: A readable profile whose deck window is NOT open. The profile comes off disk, so grid, titles and faces are all real; the press needs the window, which is not there. It carries a capture frame on purpose — a widget that polled for pixels anyway would slice it and look correct — and the host would answer no capture in reality. Named separately from a network deck because the host no longer offers one of those at all: a deck that cannot be pressed is refused upstream, not rendered.
